# Fauzan Fathurrahman — Software Engineer (Products, Backend Systems & Developer Tools)

> Software engineer building products, backend systems, and developer tools: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Go, Python, PostgreSQL on AWS, with deep test automation experience (Playwright, K6, CI/CD at scale). Previously Senior Software Engineer in Test at FrankieOne. Applying to backend, full-stack, frontend, and SDET/QA roles; selective freelance. Based in Bandung, working remotely with teams in Australia, the US, and Indonesia since 2021.

Personal site: case studies with problem/solution/result structure, a technical blog, experience history, and a hire page. Canonical domain: https://fau.ai.id/

## Case studies

- [UsedCheck](https://fau.ai.id/projects/usedcheck/): offline-first Android app for inspecting second-hand laptops — React Native, SQLite, 74 automated tests
- [COCOK](https://fau.ai.id/projects/cocok/): multi-tenant financial reconciliation platform — Go, Next.js, PostgreSQL; 9.4ms p95 (local k6, 5 VU)
- [IncidentScope](https://fau.ai.id/projects/incidentscope/): third-party service reliability intelligence — Python pipeline, PostgreSQL analytics
- [Incident Queue](https://fau.ai.id/projects/incident-queue/): real-time multiplayer card game — Express, Socket.IO, React, Playwright e2e
- [PUP](https://fau.ai.id/projects/pup/): production bowel-movement tracker on Google Play — React Native, NestJS, offline-first monorepo
- [JobPilot](https://fau.ai.id/projects/jobpilot/): Chrome extension automating job applications — Manifest V3, client-side AI
- [Senara](https://fau.ai.id/projects/senara/): free interactive story platform teaching life skills — Astro, i18n
- [SpeakUp](https://fau.ai.id/projects/speakup/): offline-first PWA for English speaking practice
- [AI Test Case Generator](https://fau.ai.id/projects/ai-test-generator/): Jira tickets to test cases in 30 seconds — AWS Bedrock
- [Chatbiz Chatbot Platform](https://fau.ai.id/projects/chatbiz-chatbots/): 30+ chatbots handling 100k+ messages/day
- [Fantasy Showdown](https://fau.ai.id/projects/fantasy-showdown/): fantasy sports platform with live scoring
- [Axiomara](https://fau.ai.id/projects/axiomara/): interactive discrete mathematics simulator
- [Narrative Tracker](https://fau.ai.id/projects/narrative-tracker/): controversy timelines and actor networks
